trap.label: if + passado / dedução
trap.wrong: If I would have time, it must to be fun.
trap.right: If I had time, it would be fun.
trap.why: Em português “se eu tivesse, seria” usa subjuntivo; o brasileiro coloca would no if e confunde must com would. Em inglês: if + Past, would + base; must é dedução, não condição.

mcq.q: If I ___ time, I would go.

fix.wrong: If I would know, I would help.
fix.right: If I knew, I would help.

fix.wrong: He must be to the office.
fix.right: He must be at the office.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no 2º condicional: “If I have money, I will travel.”
rewrite.answer: If I had money, I would travel.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com dedução (presente): “I am sure he is at work.”
